tools.description: Search the brain across two planes and return the envelope {memory, documents, freshness}. Memory-plane hits are entity targets: entity_id, entity_surface, entity_type, score, snippet. Documents-plane hits carry verbatim text slices with their doc:// provenance (root, locator, revision, ordinal). as_of (valid time) and min_confidence filter beliefs; a belief that is retracted or contradicted at as_of is excluded.

as_of.description: Valid-time instant (millis since epoch). Only beliefs true at this instant are returned (default: now).

known_at.description: Transaction-time instant (millis since epoch). Only beliefs recorded by this instant are returned (default: now).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: search

tools.description: Assemble context for a query within a token budget — the per-turn call for agents. Returns layered context: profile, high-salience beliefs (with subjects, validity, support), query neighborhood, summaries with their sources, and recent episodes.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

token_budget.description: Maximum tokens for the assembled context (default: 3000).

tools.name: recall

tools.description: Render a page as Markdown with followable links. Three target kinds: `entity` (an entity page: identity, aliases, current beliefs, contradictions, neighbours, timeline, sources — the M9 §9.2 brief); `space` (counts + top entities); `topic` (keyword search over entity surfaces). The target_kind discriminator is purely additive; existing callers using only `entity_id` keep working.

entity_id.description: Required when target_kind=entity. The entity's content-derived ID.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

target_kind.description: Which brief to render. Default: entity.

topic.description: Required when target_kind=topic. A keyword to match against entity surface forms (case-insensitive substring).

tools.name: brief

tools.description: Follow a followable link from a rendered page to another entity page. Returns the target's brief.

from.description: The view/page the link came from (e.g. an entity:// id).

link.description: The link to follow (entity://<id> or a raw entity id).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: navigate

tools.description: Resolve an entity surface form + type to its content-derived id — the legal path to ids. Ids are derived (never guessed); an id slot in any other op rejects a surface string instead of silently resolving it.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

surface.description: The entity's surface form as declared.

tools.name: resolve

tools.description: Ingest text content as a new Primary episode. Set extract:true to trigger realtime extraction via client sampling (§12.3) — the server asks the client's model to extract claims. Requires the Sample capability on authenticated sessions.

extract.description: If true, extract claims via client sampling immediately (default: false).

source_path.description: Optional source label, e.g. a file path (default: mcp).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

trust.description: Requested trust tier. Requires trusted_ingest capability for 'trusted'. Default: trusted (parity with the note path until the policy engine lands).

tools.name: ingest

tools.description: Declare a statement deterministically (no LLM). Takes a declaration JSON: {op, subject, predicate, object, polarity, valid_from, valid_to}. Writes a Declaration episode.

declaration_json.description: Canonical declaration JSON (op = add_statement | merge | retract).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: declare

tools.description: Get provenance for a statement — supporting/denying assertions with confidence breakdown, extractors, and source episodes.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: why

tools.description: List all contradicted statements in a space — statements with both affirming and denying support.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: contradictions

tools.description: Bounded subgraph traversal from a set of start entities. Returns nodes and edges within the depth/node budget. The graph is belief-filtered: retracted and contradicted edges are excluded (valid_at filters valid time). Useful for multi-hop recall (ToG driver).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

start.description: Entity IDs to start from (at least one required).

valid_at.description: Valid-time instant (millis since epoch). Walk the graph as believed at this instant (default: now).

tools.name: traverse

tools.description: One-shot ingest + sync extraction for short user facts. Ingests text as a Primary episode and immediately extracts claims via client sampling. Requires the Sample capability on authenticated sessions.

content.description: The fact or note to remember.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

trust.description: Requested trust tier. Requires trusted_ingest capability for 'trusted'. Default: trusted (parity with the note path until the policy engine lands).

tools.name: remember

tools.description: Retract a statement. Prefer the statement_id form — the declaration is rebuilt from the stored statement (no surfaces/types needed); this retracts ALL assertions of the statement. The subject/predicate/object form is the legacy resubmission path. Creates a Declaration episode.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

statement_id.description: Statement to retract — takes precedence over subject/predicate/object.

tools.name: retract

tools.description: Merge two entities: the loser is redirected to the winner. Creates a Declaration episode. Both refs use surface form + type.

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

tools.name: merge_entities

tools.description: Destructive: remove episodes, entities, or predicates from the brain. Writes audit first, then tombstones. Use dry_run to preview the closure first.

dry_run.description: Preview the closure without modifying anything (default: false).

space.description: Space name (required; enumerate with oxibrain describe).

target_id.description: Episode ID, entity ID, or 'entity_id/predicate' for predicate kind.

tools.name: redact
